# Stampelo

Stampelo is an online digital stamp and seal creator. It provides a browser-based editor with 300+ customizable templates, multiple stamp shapes, custom icon/SVG uploads, and export in PNG, SVG, EPS, PDF, and DOCX with transparent backgrounds, plus a built-in tool to apply stamps directly to PDF documents.

Canonical site: https://www.stampelo.com/

## Core product
- Stamp editor: https://www.stampelo.com/editor
- PDF Stamp Editor: https://www.stampelo.com/pdf-editor
- Pricing: https://www.stampelo.com/pricing
- Templates: https://www.stampelo.com/templates
- About: https://www.stampelo.com/about

## Important limitation
A visual digital stamp is not automatically equivalent to an electronic signature, digital certificate, qualified electronic signature, notarisation or legal authority. Requirements depend on the document, organisation and jurisdiction.
